Raw text preserves extracted table rows, plot labels/numbers, all comparison series and OOM labels, but does not reconstruct diagrams, graphical marks, or reliable plotted-point alignment. The official PDF remains the graphical source of truth.

The source has no standalone Limitations section. Constraints within complete Methods/Experiments remain in place, while the non-summary future-scope paragraph is separately located; it is not relabeled as an author-written limitations heading.
